headline: Marvell CEO Calls Google AI Revenue Opportunity a 'Monster Number'
summary: Marvell CEO says Google's AI deal is a "monster number" and signals Wall Street may be underestimating the company's AI growth.

headline: Marvell’s Google AI Chip Deal Could Drive $120 Billion in Long-Term Revenue: Analyst
summary: Rosenblatt and Needham both raised price forecasts on Marvell Technology (MRVL) to $300 following fiscal Q2 results and an upgraded revenue outlook driven by data center demand.
